logistic_regression+walk_forward_cycle.description: Logistic regression — model cycle — L2-regularized linear classifier over the causal feature matrix. The interpretable, fast baseline every other Model Cycle family is measured against.

random_forest+walk_forward_cycle.description: Random forest — model cycle — Bagged ensemble of causal-feature decision trees, scikit-learn's RandomForestClassifier. No boosting, no early stopping — depth and leaf size are the only regularizers.

xgboost+walk_forward_cycle.description: XGBoost — model cycle — GPU histogram boosting with calibration + ECE, cost-adjusted PnL simulation, SHAP feature attribution.
